text: As artificial intelligence becomes more common in offices, it is changing how people work. Some tasks are now automated, which means machines handle repetitive jobs like data entry or sorting emails. This gives employees more time for creative or strategic work. Productivity tools that use AI can analyse large amounts of information quickly, helping teams make faster decisions. However, the workplace itself is changing too. Many people will need to learn new skills as their roles shift towards human-AI collaboration. Instead of being replaced, workers often find themselves working alongside AI systems, checking their results or using their suggestions. The key is to adapt and see AI as a helpful partner rather than a threat.
